It has not been long since I just got out of rehab when I had my second and probly the last time  ever to do amanita muscaria trip. But I wanted to get really high when I got out that horrible place that  I was forced to be there for 60 days second choice ether that or jail and the only high I got in that 60 days was from addraw that I person traded for extra pack cigarettes. But anyway once the 60 days where up I planned I was going order Amanita muscaria off the internet so I ordered 1 ounce which equaled to 3 huge caps and one small one. One of the caps was really big and they where all dried. And I ate all of them VERY BIG MISTAKE.
But before rehab I never would not toke that much but I have not got high in over 60 days and  I promised myself I would get high and I got my wish.
The Trip
I started eating the mushrooms like nothing once I got them all down I put in a movie I got this movie specially to trip to and it was grateful dead the movie which was pretty good at one point of the movie acted like the movie was over but out of nowhere It makes a loud sound and pops up the grateful dead logo scaring the crap out of me. By that time I was feeling the mushrooms very strong but still in reality. I went to get a cup of milk and picked the milk jug up and my hand some reason would not hold on to anything which I know would happen from last time but not this bad.
Which was not good my parents saw milk jug hit floor and now they know I toke some kind drug that not weed. Which got? I in little trouble but at less I didn't kicked out my house just a big boring speech once that was over I went to my room and played  Mario on gameboy which was a blast but not at all skilled as I usually am then I started watching TV.
Then some how I woke up in hospital. My parents told me they found me in my room with blood all over the bed which I vomited. And the doctor at first thought I ate Amanita phalloides also know as the deathcap which symptoms are stomach pains, vomiting, diarrhoea, coma, and death. But I was in hospital for 2 days in a coma for 1 day and my neck was so soar because the tube that was lunged up in my throat but at less I really was not there to feel them put the tube in. I  try to remember some of what it was like to be in coma but I know this much when I was in coma I forgot all about even my name or even being alive and the world I was in was very uncomfortable and that all I remember.
